stories.full: AYU sought a new face for its popular cosmetics and, via Sport Endorse, selected champion jockey Nina Carberry. Nina embodies AYU's values of hard work, loyalty and determination, showing what can be achieved through dedication.
stories.quote: Nina personifies what the AYU brand is all about — that dreams come true if we have the courage to pursue them.

stories.title: VHI × Nina Carberry — 'More Than Running' parkrun Campaign
stories.blurb: Former jockey Nina Carberry led VHI's 'More Than Running' parkrun campaign, highlighting the health benefits of taking part.
stories.full: VHI launched its 'More Than Running' campaign highlighting the health benefits of parkrun. Former professional jockey Nina Carberry was a first-choice ambassador, leading by example and taking part in park runs across Ireland, where more than 8,000 people participate every weekend.
stories.quote: We love that there's a place for everyone at parkrun — walk, jog, run or volunteer.
stories.quote_by: Brighid Smyth, Head of Corporate Communications, VHI

stories.title: permanent tsb × Nhat Nguyen — Team Ireland Sponsorship
stories.blurb: Tokyo Olympian Nhat Nguyen became a permanent tsb ambassador as the bank backed Team Ireland's Olympic and Paralympic athletes.
stories.full: permanent tsb became the first-ever title sponsor to partner with both the Irish Olympic and Paralympic teams across an Olympic cycle. Tokyo Olympian and badminton star Nhat Nguyen was selected as one of four world-class ambassadors, with plenty of activation planned toward Paris 2024.
stories.quote: We see our community ethos as a key differentiator — this is a perfect partnership.

stories.title: ShinAwiL (RTÉ) × Nina Carberry & Nicolas Roche — Dancing with the Stars
stories.blurb: Sport Endorse placed jockey Nina Carberry and cyclist Nicolas Roche on RTÉ's Dancing with the Stars — Nina was crowned champion.
stories.full: ShinAwiL, producer of RTÉ's Dancing with the Stars, considered elite sports talent for its 2022 series. Former jockey Nina Carberry and former professional cyclist Nicolas Roche both took part — Nico reached the quarter-finals, and Nina and partner Pasquale La Rocca were crowned champions.

stories.title: MINI UK × Laura Siddall — Friend of the Brand
stories.blurb: World-class triathlete Laura Siddall became a MINI UK Friend of the Brand — an athlete-led partnership driven by genuine passion.
stories.full: Laura Siddall — world-class triathlete, engineering graduate and former British Army officer — was passionate about MINI UK. Sport Endorse reached out, and Laura became a Friend of the Brand, sharing her passion while broadening MINI's reach among sports enthusiasts.
stories.quote: I was delighted when through Sport Endorse I was made a Friend of the Brand for MINI UK.

stories.title: Good4U × 15 Athletes — Brand-Awareness Programme
stories.blurb: Sligo-made healthy-food brand Good4U engaged 15 athletes on the Sport Endorse platform to boost awareness and product reviews.
stories.full: Good4U, a family-owned Sligo food business, engaged 15 athletes when version 1.0 of the Sport Endorse platform launched, boosting brand awareness and gathering product reviews.
stories.quote: The platform looks great — we're happy to collaborate with so many athlete ambassadors on it.
stories.quote_by: Mark Butler, Sales & Media Marketer, Good4U

stories.title: Nuasan × Multi-Sport Athletes — Product Launch
stories.blurb: Natural Irish skin-and-bodycare brand Nuasan launched with elite athletes across four sports for broad reach.
stories.full: Nuasan, a producer of natural Irish-made skin and bodycare, turned to elite athletes to launch its products. Engaging athletes from four different sports ensured broad reach and successful collaborations for the growing brand.
stories.quote: I couldn't believe I could access so many professional athletes — the platform delivered all that.
stories.quote_by: Maria O'Donnell, Sales & Market Manager, Nuasan

stories.title: Benetti Menswear × Ronan O'Gara — AW21 Launch
stories.blurb: Rugby legend Ronan O'Gara fronted Benetti Menswear's AW21 launch on a multi-year deal, timed with the Rugby Nations Series.
stories.full: Benetti Menswear launched its AW21 range with a well-known ambassador. Ronan O'Gara was selected on a multi-year deal, with the launch timed to the 2021 Rugby Nations Series for excellent coverage.
stories.quote: Ronan is great to work with and hugely popular with our retailers and the public — Sport Endorse have been great too.

stories.title: Mind Your Mouth × Shauna Kendrick — Ambassador
stories.blurb: Gaelic footballer Shauna Kendrick fronted Irish oral-care brand Mind Your Mouth's custom gum-shield awareness campaign.
stories.full: Mind Your Mouth, a 100% Irish-owned oral-care brand, used the platform to secure Gaelic footballer Shauna Kendrick as an ambassador for its custom gum-shield product, suitable from non-contact sports to boxing and MMA.
stories.quote: Great platform to find a huge variety of sports persons — we were extremely pleased.
stories.quote_by: Matthew Hogan, Co-Founder, Mind Your Mouth

stories.title: Wellington Eye Clinic × Claire McLaughlin — Ambassador
stories.blurb: International rugby player and doctor Claire McLaughlin became the Wellington Eye Clinic ambassador after her own laser eye surgery.
stories.full: The Wellington Eye Clinic sought a sports-active ambassador who would benefit from laser eye surgery. Claire McLaughlin — doctor, Irish women's rugby international and BBC pundit — was ideal, sharing her life-changing 20/20 result.
stories.quote: It's honestly been life changing for me — in my job, my sport and everyday life.

stories.title: Remus Uomo × Nicolas Roche & Philip Doyle — AW21 Collection
stories.blurb: Menswear brand Remus Uomo promoted its AW21 collection with cycling legend Nicolas Roche and Olympian rower Philip Doyle.
stories.full: Remus Uomo used Sport Endorse to select cycling legend Nicolas Roche and Olympian rower Philip Doyle to promote its AW21 collection, showing both look as sharp out of sports gear as in it.
stories.quote: The platform allowed the brand to access two of the country's best athletes to build followers and awareness.
stories.quote_by: Michael Finlay, Brand Director, Remus Uomo

stories.title: Grant Thornton × GT5K Ambassadors — Community 5K
stories.blurb: Grant Thornton sourced race, city and social ambassadors for its all-island GT5K over several years via Sport Endorse.
stories.full: Grant Thornton runs the all-island GT5K road race with Athletics Ireland, sourcing city, overall and social ambassadors via Sport Endorse over several years — including runner Brian Gregan, rugby player Eimear Considine, GAA footballer Boidu Sayeh and James Lowe.

stories.title: Ireland West Airport × Jack Carty & Jason Quigley — Ambassadors
stories.blurb: Rugby's Jack Carty and boxer Jason Quigley promoted Ireland West Airport, backing local sports talent from the region.
stories.full: Ireland West Airport sought sports ambassadors to promote international travel while supporting local talent. Connacht and Ireland rugby player Jack Carty and Donegal boxer Jason Quigley were selected for photo and video shoots, campaigns and social media.
stories.quote: We were delighted to work with Sport Endorse on campaigns with two outstanding ambassadors for the West.
stories.quote_by: Donal Healy, Head of Marketing, Ireland West Airport

stories.title: Specsavers × Lee Keegan & Frank Burns — All-Ireland Mini-Activation
stories.blurb: A playful pre-All-Ireland-final mini-activation had 'little journalists' interview Mayo and Tyrone players for Specsavers.
stories.full: Before the 2021 All-Ireland Football final, Tangerine Comms and Specsavers ran a mini-activation where 'little journalists' interviewed key Mayo and Tyrone players. The players and interview panel were sourced via Sport Endorse for a buzzy, successful activation.
stories.quote: They get things done when others may say it isn't possible.
stories.quote_by: Filsan Yusuf, Senior Digital Account Director

stories.title: Magnet+ × Eimear Lambe — Brand-Launch Campaign
stories.blurb: Tokyo Olympic bronze medallist rower Eimear Lambe personified performance excellence for the launch of connectivity brand Magnet+.
stories.full: For the launch of Magnet+, formed from Airspeed Telecom and Magnet Networks, a sports celebrity was sought who personified individual and team excellence. Tokyo Olympic bronze medallist rower Eimear Lambe was the ideal fit for Ireland's largest connectivity provider.
stories.quote: The team at Sport Endorse were a pleasure to work with — a great experience we will no doubt repeat.

stories.title: Revive Active × John Egan — UK Brand Ambassador
stories.blurb: Ireland and Sheffield United's John Egan became Revive Active's Zest Active ambassador, deepening the brand's UK penetration.
stories.full: Revive Active sought greater UK brand penetration and found a strong match in Ireland and Sheffield United player John Egan via Sport Endorse. John was appointed ambassador for Zest Active, which became Sheffield United's official immunity partner.
